provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled material-physics study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

models.wenzel: cos(theta_app)=r*cos(theta_Young) for the completely wetted rough surface.
models.cassie_baxter: cos(theta_app)=f_s*(cos(theta_Young)+1)-1 for solid/air composite contact; f_s is projected solid area fraction.

uncertainty_policy: Angle intervals are inclusive independent deterministic bounds, not Gaussian standard errors. First bound f_s sharply over both complete angle intervals without applying its separate geometric measurement. A supplied model is compatible only if some choice of all its bounded inputs reproduces the apparent-angle interval and, for Cassie, f_s also lies in the independent geometric interval.
nominal_angle: For the separate nominal Wenzel number use theta_Young=100degrees.
scope: The two ideal wetting formulas are a finite model screen, not an exhaustive description of pinning, metastability, chemical heterogeneity or all possible surface states. Compatibility alone does not uniquely prove an actual microstructure.
